text:
morgan: Heads-up — planning to bring up a small tenant pilot in ap-east-2 next week, need accelerated entitlement for p5 + p4d + g5 and ENI bump.
elena: Can you confirm account and VPC details? also subnet sizes, we hit /28 limits last time.
morgan: Account 987654321000, VPC vpc-0a1b2c3d, subnets in az-a/b/c are /26 each. Expected start: 2026-04-01. Initial ask: 8 p5.48xlarge, 12 p4d.24xlarge (short term), 40 g5.48xlarge for burst pool.
raj: +1 on the ENI lift request — what's the expected concurrent ENI per instance? p5/p4d use ENI=1 but we need IPv4 addresses for sidecars.
kai: For p5 we typically reserve 4 ENIs per instance for infra. What's the NAT/EIP plan? last pilot saturated NAT gateways.
morgan: Planning to use NAT GW per AZ with EIP pool handled by infra team. Requesting 200 additional ENIs across the account and a 50 NAT gateway ephemeral EIP quota to avoid throttles.
elena: Cost note — if we run all on-demand it'll be expensive. Can we mix spot for non-critical batch runs and reserved/dedicated for the low-latency slices?
morgan: Yes, plan is: 50% on-demand for canary + dedicated SLA, rest spot for training. We'll provide an autoscaling policy to avoid cold starts.
raj: Please open an entitlement case with AWS and share SR number. Also add cloudops-accounts@ for approval and billing owner.
morgan: Opened case SR-8765432101 with AWS (mentioning p5,p4d,g5 entitlement increase + ENI bump + EIP quota). AWS replied asking for expected sustained spend and SRE contact.
kai: I'll paste the cost projection to the case: monthly steady-state ~ $280k (on-demand + NAT fees) and peak burst ~ $420k. Adding that helps.
infra-bot: Reminder: submit request in our internal capacity tracker (https://redwood.internal/capacity) and tag "ap-east-2-pilot" — infra will triage within 24h.
morgan: Done — tracker ID CAP-2026-114. Added runbook link and rollout window (2026-04-01 02:00-08:00 UTC).
elena: Network preflight: ensure subnets have /24 available IPs for scaling. If not, we need to expand or attach secondary CIDRs.
raj: Also ensure KMS key policy is in place for model weights if private dataset — security will check.
kai: Action items: 1) infra to confirm ENI/EIP availability by EOD, 2) cloudops to attach billing owner to SR, 3) raj to validate KMS and IAM, 4) morgan to coordinate canary traffic routing. I'll follow up in the morning.
morgan: Thanks. If AWS gives a partial entitlement (e.g., only g5), we'll fallback to split routing: low-latency requests -> p5, bulk -> g5/p4d. Will update SR with fallback plan.
aws-support-bot: Case SR-8765432101 updated: AWS says preliminary approval pending region capacity checks, please provide expected start date and internal contact (SRE oncall).
morgan: Provided SRE oncall = kai, start date 2026-04-01. pinging infra channel for final network approval. :crossed_fingers:
elena: Approved pending NAT/EIP confirmation. If AWS needs a soft-commit, we can request a short-term reserved capacity for the pilot.
raj: Noted. I'll review IAM/KMS later today and flag any blockers.
kai: Following up tomorrow AM with AWS case progress. If we get greenlight, I'll schedule the environment bootstrap starting 02:00 UTC.
morgan: Great — thanks everyone. I'll keep the channel updated and drop the SR link to the tracker. :thumbsup:
